summary: Zedge amended an 8-K to detail a completed private placement of Class B common stock and warrants to insiders and a third stockholder. Effective September 23, 2026, Vice Chairman Howard Jonas assigned his purchase rights to Chartwell Holding LLC, a family entity, covering $6.5 million for 2,218,430 shares and warrants on 1,996,587 shares; the warrant share figure was corrected from an earlier 8-K. On September 25, 2026, Zedge closed the placement, issuing 2,616,447 shares and warrants on 2,354,803 shares for $7,675,000 gross. Warrant exercise prices are $3.22 for Chartwell and director Elliot Gibber, $3.28 for the remaining purchaser, pending NYSE American stockholder approval.
